method: Sequential GET of each product URL (1.5s delay, desktop UA), read-only. Gallery from .woocommerce-product-gallery__wrapper data-large_image, in DOM order, with the WordPress -WxH size suffix stripped so the full-size original is requested. Sizes from select[name^=attribute_] and form.variations_form data-product_variations (the review star-rating select#rating is excluded). Price from div.summary p.price cross-checked against the embedded product JSON. Stock from schema.org offers availability, p.stock and per-variation availability_html. Attributes from table.woocommerce-product-attributes.

totals.note_on_counts: Occurrence counts double-count the 5 images that appear in two products' galleries (Sweatbands-Black-White.jpg, Lockable-Spout.png, Screw-on-Cap.png, Jesse-Caron-Sport-Shirt-Wit-Zwart-Logo.jpg, Jesse-Caron-Shirt-Wit-Kids-Detail.jpg). Each file was fetched once.
